completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8421_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Barangay Abaroan Annex of the Roxas National Comprehensive High School in Roxas, Palawan, shall be converted to a national high school to be known as Abaroan National High School.

All assets, immovable and movable, and records of Roxas National Comprehensive High School Annex at Barangay Abaroan, as well as its liabilities or obligations, are hereby transferred to the Abaroan National High School: Provided, however , That the positions, rights and security of tenure of academic and nonacademic personnel who choose to remain and serve in the new school shall not be impaired.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in two (2) newspapers of general and nationwide circulation.
